definitions.full: H8356. shathah or shath [ שָׁת ] noun masculine (Albr ZAW xvi (1896), 84 ) foundation, stay (of society) (√ שׁית Thes Kö ii. l. 172 ); — plural יֵהָרֵס֑וּן הַשָּׁתוֺת Psa 11:3 (probably figurative of established usages, laws , etc., ᵑ9 leges , Symm θεσμοί , so Hup-Now Bae Che (1888) and others; > Thes and others of nobles ); Thes puts here also שָֽׁתֹתֶ֫יהָ Isa 19:10 (so ᵑ0 probably intends), which Ew Di Kit then interpret of working-classes, || שֶׂכֶר עשֵֹׁי ; but perhaps opposed to of this, the upper classes, so as to include all ranks of society, Thes De Che Comm .; Che Hpt Buhl and others שֹׁתֶיהָ weavers of it (compare Du Marti), see III. שׁתה .
